source_line: PAI Design Workbench · AI autopilot run, Claude under a maintainer grant · UI in Chinese

segments.headline: 6202 bearing housing: Ø35 H7 bore, wall ≥ 5 mm, M8 bolt edge ≥ 1.5 d
segments.detail: Mass budget 175 g. The requirement version is frozen before any design work

segments.step: 2  A compact candidate fails a native check
segments.headline: Base 88 mm, bolt pitch 76 mm: lighter, but the bolt holes move to the edge
segments.detail: CadQuery measures the edge distance: {facts.compact.edge} mm against {facts.compact.required} mm ({facts.compact.mass} g). Rejected

segments.step: 3  A maintainer grants a narrow scope
segments.headline: AI may revise the CAD part only: at most 3 attempts within 8 hours
segments.detail: It cannot relax requirements, accept, release or close feedback. One real model call, no auto-retry

segments.step: 4  The executor stops for a human
segments.headline: It cannot prove the model call had no side effects, so it waits
segments.detail: Receipt: read-only mode, no tool activity. The maintainer reconciles it inside the same grant

segments.headline: {facts.ai.engine}: W {facts.ai.parameters.width}, base {facts.ai.parameters.baseDepth} × {facts.ai.parameters.baseThickness} mm, pitch {facts.ai.parameters.boltPitch}. Edge now {facts.ai.edge} mm. Its estimate: ≤ 170 g
segments.detail: Measured {facts.ai.mass} g against the 175 g limit: {facts.ai.verdict}. The solver decided, not the AI

segments.headline: 1 kN uplift load on the bore: axis displacement ≤ 10 µm, bore distortion ≤ 6 µm
segments.detail: Next: a physics search. Reference plus Sobol seeds, then a surrogate ranks each round

segments.step: 7  Every recommendation is solved for real
segments.headline: Surrogate ranks, B-Rep screens, Gmsh meshes, CalculiX solves
segments.detail: The surrogate only orders the queue. Every reported point is a solver result

segments.headline: {facts.optimize.solved} CalculiX solves, {facts.optimize.feasible} feasible. Best: {facts.optimize.best.mass} g, bore distortion {um:facts.optimize.best.bore} µm
segments.detail: Reference {facts.optimize.reference.mass} g, so {lighter:facts.optimize.best.mass|facts.optimize.reference.mass} % lighter. Searched under the 250 g family default; also meets 175 g

segments.step: 9  Formal review on two mesh levels
segments.headline: Bore distortion {um:facts.formal.bore} µm ≤ 6 µm at {facts.formal.mass} g: all checks pass

segments.step: 10  The last failure case is closed, not forgotten
segments.headline: Logged, re-tested against the frozen requirement, then closed
segments.detail: A feedback item can close only through a bound retest

segments.step: 11  Admission check, then a signed release
segments.headline: Bound to requirement version 1, every failure case closed: STEP and FEA report released
segments.detail: Signed with a local Ed25519 key in this recording. The hosted site signs with AWS KMS
